subject: Re: Seniority band retargeting & seat swap for runtime squad
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Seniority band retargeting & seat swap for runtime squad

Team —

I want to propose a short headcount retarget to unblock our KV-cache / continuous-batching work that is currently falling behind. Summary: swap one open SRE/edge-serving seat (unfilled) into the runtime infra roster and elevate the role to L5 to align with the experience we need.

Why: the candidate pipeline we have for the existing edge role is more junior (L4) and will not deliver the performance engineering leadership required for our low-latency initiatives. We have a strong candidate (JSnyder) who would take the runtime L5 slot and accelerate the caching work that can materially reduce per-token cost in Q3.

Ask: please approve (a) reassigning the headcount from edge-serving to runtime infra, and (b) approving an L5 band for the role and the attached target comp range.

Attachments: banding_matrix_q2.xlsx (current comp bands), seat-swap-diagram.png (org view), candidate-pack-JSnyder.pdf (summary + ref checks).

If we can lock this by next Wednesday (2027-06-02) Recruiting (Jenna) can make an L5 offer at market and we can target a July start. Note: I added the HR ticket for traceability: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/HR-2319

Short bullet impacts:
- Technical: +1 senior infra SWE on runtime => prioritized KV cache rewrite + batching optimizations (estimated 18% token-cost reduction).
- Org: edge-serving loses one open seat (we still cover pager rota for Q2).
- Budget: neutral for FY27 headcount (swap), comp delta depends on band selection (L5 vs L4).

Open to options (e.g., parallel hire, but that requires extra budget).

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seniority band retargeting & seat swap for runtime squad

Irene — thanks for the summary. A couple quick questions before I sign off: 

1) Can you confirm the expected comp delta if we move the open seat from L4->L5? I looked at the attached banding_matrix_q2.xlsx but want the net delta (delta on run-rate this FY).
2) Any impact to SLO coverage for edge-serving if we take the seat? Who covers the oncall gap?

If the comp delta is small and Marcus can cover the rotation, I’m inclined to approve. If the delta is material we need to route through Karthik for reallocation (cc’d).

On the candidate: do we have any counteroffers in flight or competing processes? If not, Recruiting should move fast — losing a solid L5 candidate would be costly.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seniority band retargeting & seat swap for runtime squad

+1 from me. Operational note: we’re currently 2x over target on perf backlog items tied to KV cache complexity and suboptimal batching heuristics. I’ve attached a quick note in the Drive folder showing projected latency improvements if we prioritize this hire (see the dashboard link in the original email).

Oncall: I can temporarily cover the edge rota for two cycles (I’ll reorganize rotations with Soojin). It’s not ideal long-term but buys us the runway to land the L5 and get the intra-team knowledge transfer scheduled.

Candidate risk: JSnyder has one other process (small cloud infra startup) but recruiting indicated the other process is slower. Jenna (recruiter) is ready to mark priority if we get approval.

Marcus
Senior Director, Runtime Engineering
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seniority band retargeting & seat swap for runtime squad

Irene / team — quick finance note. Since this is a level elevation inside the same headcount bucket (swap), FY27 headcount numbers remain unchanged. However payroll run-rate increases for L5 vs L4 for the remainder of the year — my estimate (back-of-envelope) is +$48k run-rate impact if we hire at the mid of L5 band. That will pull against the hiring contingency we set in Q1; we have ~3 unallocated comp points remaining. If you want to proceed, add the precise target comp to the HR ticket and I’ll approve reallocation from contingency.

Also: please include the seat-swap-diagram.png in the ticket so PeopleOps can update org charts.

-Karthik
VP, Finance Planning & Ops
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-02T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seniority band retargeting & seat swap for runtime squad

Approved — move forward.

Notes:
- Approve swapping the open edge-serving seat into runtime infra and hiring at L5.
- Karthik: approve the ~+$48k run-rate variance from the hiring contingency; please post the allocation to HR-2319.
- Marcus: proceed with temporary oncall cover and partner with Recruiting (Jenna) to issue the L5 offer. Target comp: $235k base midpoint, equity + standard package (add explicit numbers to ticket).

On the candidate communication: Jenna — go ahead and prioritize JSnyder and tell the candidate we expect an offer by 2027-06-07 if approvals are final.

Thanks,
Soojin
Head of Platform Engineering
